test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The radius of a road roller is 1 { m} , and its length is (21)/(22) { m} . When it is rolled on the ground, it takes 600 rolls to level the entire ground. However, it was found that on 10% of the ground, the roller rolled twice. What is the total area (in sq. m) of the ground?

(Use pi = (22)/(7) , and round off your answer to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area per roll = 2πr × l = 2 × 22/7 × 1 × 21/22 = 6 m²

Let total area = A

Effective rolls = 600 but 10% area rolled twice ⇒ extra = 0.1A

Total work = A + 0.1A = 1.1A = 600 × 6

**∴ Answer = 3272.73 m²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius = 1 m, Length = 21/22 m, Rolls = 600, 10% area rolled twice

**Formula used:**

Area covered in one roll = Curved surface area = 2πr × l

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area per roll = 2 × (22/7) × 1 × (21/22)

⇒ = 2 × 3 = 6 m²

⇒ Total area covered by 600 rolls = 600 × 6 = 3600 m²

⇒ Let actual ground area = A

⇒ 10% area rolled twice ⇒ extra coverage = 0.1A

⇒ Total effective coverage = A + 0.1A = 1.1A

⇒ 1.1A = 3600

⇒ A = 3600 ÷ 1.1

⇒ A = 3272.73 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 3272.73 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder

CSA = 2πr × h

Rolling Concept

Area covered per roll equals curved surface area

Double Coverage Concept

If some area is rolled twice, it adds extra coverage

Percentage Conversion

10% = 0.1 in decimal form
